triples.head_canonical_zh: 主动部件（如泵、加热器等）
triples.tail_surface: cross-connect the auxiliary service systems and size the active components (pumps, heaters, etc.) to be capable of supplying two or more propulsion machines simultaneously
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 互连辅助服务系统并配置主动部件使其能同时供应两台及以上推进机械
triples.evidence_text: In order to meet this requirement, it will be necessary to either cross-connect the auxiliary service systems and size the active components (pumps, heaters, etc.) to be capable of supplying two or more propulsion machines simultaneously, or provide duplicate active components (pumps, heaters, etc.) in each auxiliary system in case one fails.

triples.tail_surface: A spare pump is required to be carried
triples.evidence_text: the failure of the attached pump is not to degrade the vessel propulsion capability beyond what is permitted in 4-3-7/7, (half design speed or 7 knots, whichever is less.) A spare pump is required to be carried.

triples.tail_surface: Position status of the disconnection or isolation means is to be provided at the navigation bridge and the centralized control station
